description: Life steal / Vampire buff. Converts a portion of damage dealt into healing for the caster. Factors in Total DMG Add/Def, skill-specific damage multiplier, heal cap based on max HP percentage, and treat decay. Can be limited to specific skills.

param1.description: Calculation type. Currently only type 0 is implemented (total damage based).

param2.description: Cap type. Currently only type 0 is implemented (max HP percentage cap).

param3.description: Maximum heal cap as basis points of max HP (per 10000). E.g. 5000 = 50% of max HP.

param5.description: Array of skill IDs. If non-empty, vampire only triggers for these skills.

skillPar: Not directly used in formula (skillDam from skill config is used instead)

calDamage.description: Called when the caster deals damage. Calculates and applies life steal healing.

parameters.target: The unit that received the damage
parameters.skillId: The skill that dealt the damage

steps: 1. Check skill filter: if _limitSkill is non-empty and skillId not in list, skip
8. skillDamFactor = round((skillDam[0] XOR CONFIG_KEY) / 10000) [from skill config, encrypted]
11. If healAmount < healCap: effectiveCap = healAmount / treatDecay
formula.formula_compact: heal = min(round(damage * totalDamMul) / injuryReduce * skillDamFactor, hpCap) / treatDecay

globalConfigReferences.total_damage_add_down_limit: Minimum floor for total damage multiplier (from ConfigGlobal)
globalConfigReferences.CONFIG_KEY: XOR decryption key for skill damage values

notes: The XOR with CONFIG_KEY (line 196772-196773) is an obfuscation/encryption mechanism for skill damage values
Vampire triggers from target's buff list (checked on target, heals caster)
Only triggers if caster matches the vampire buff's runner.cast or runner.cast.parent
